items.headline: Aiden Flora's career day leads Cyclones' offensive onslaught in 55-7 win over Bowling Green
items.description: — Aiden Flora ran for 179 of his career-high 194 yards in the first half and returned a punt 66 yards for a touchdown, and Cameron Pettaway scored on a 100-yard kick return against his old team as Iowa State rolled past Bowling Green 55-7 on Saturday.
